upgrades.name: Combat Phase · Time Tokens
upgrades.text: Start of Combat Phase: place 3 Time tokens on this card and place a Critical and Time token next to this ship.

upgrades.name: Combat Phase · Cloaked Turn
upgrades.text: Start of Combat Phase: if this ship is Cloaked and has no enemy ship in its Zone 1, gain an Auxiliary Power token and rotate 90 degrees toward the nearest enemy ship.

upgrades.name: Combat Phase · Defensive Support
upgrades.text: Friendly ships at Range 1–2 roll +1 defense die if they have a lower Hull value than this ship.

upgrades.name: Attack · Strip Green Tokens
upgrades.text: When attacking an enemy at Range 1 with a greater Hull value, remove all Green tokens from beside that ship and place one fewer Time tokens next to this ship.

upgrades.name: Attack · Shields Down
upgrades.text: When attacking at Range 1–2, if this ship has no active shields, convert all Battle Stations results to Critical results.

upgrades.name: Defense · Delayed Attack Die
upgrades.text: When defending, place 1 Time token on this card. When attacking, roll +1 attack die.

upgrades.name: Activation · Extra Maneuver
upgrades.text: After this ship performs a maneuver, if there are no ships within Range 1–3, place 3 Time tokens on this card and perform an additional maneuver.

upgrades.name: Activation Phase · Zone Turn
upgrades.text: At the start of the Activation Phase, if this ship has an enemy ship in its forward zone, perform a white 2-turn maneuver.

upgrades.name: Planning · Shield Assault
upgrades.text: At the start of Planning, target an enemy ship at Range 1 with active shields. Roll 3 attack dice; disable one active shield for each Critical result.

upgrades.name: Attack · Weapon Restriction
upgrades.text: When attacking with a weapon restriction, place 3 Time tokens here, place an M5 Klingon ship this round if able, and roll +1 attack die while converting a result to Critical.

upgrades.name: Attack · Cancel Defense
upgrades.text: During Modify Defense Dice, if the defender is in this ship's forward zone, place an Auxiliary Power token next to this ship and cancel one Evade result.

upgrades.name: Defense · Critical Conversion
upgrades.text: During the Deal Damage step, place 1 Time token on this card to cancel one Critical result and add one Hit result.

upgrades.name: End Phase · Token Recovery
upgrades.text: During End Phase cleanup, if this ship has no green tokens, place 2 tokens next to this ship.

upgrades.name: Attack · Critical Result
upgrades.text: During Modify Attack Dice, convert one result to a Critical result, then add one Critical result.

upgrades.name: Attack · Drain Target Tokens
upgrades.text: During Declare Target, if the target is at Range 1 with a greater Hull value, remove its Green tokens and place the same number of Time tokens next to this ship.

upgrades.name: Planning · Formation Time
upgrades.text: At the start of Planning, if more friendly ships are within Range 1–2 than enemy ships, place 1 Time token next to this ship.

upgrades.name: Attack · Coordinated Assault
upgrades.text: During Declare Target, place 3 Time tokens here. Other M5 ships this round attack this ship's target if able, roll +1 attack die, and convert a result to Critical.

upgrades.name: Attack · Add Hit
upgrades.text: During the Deal Damage step, if this attack hits, place 2 Time tokens on this card and add 1 Hit result.

upgrades.name: Activation · Fleet Action
upgrades.text: After the Perform Action step, place 2 Time tokens here. Place a Battle Stations token next to this ship and all friendly ships at Range 1–2.

upgrades.name: Defense · Cloaked Conversion
upgrades.text: During Modify Defense Dice, if this ship has a Cloak token, roll +1 defense die and convert one result into an Evade result.

upgrades.name: Attack · Cloaked Firepower
upgrades.text: When rolling attack dice while cloaked, add +2 dice at Range 1 or +1 die at Range 2.

upgrades.name: Activation · Long-Range Maneuver
upgrades.text: After this ship performs a maneuver, if no enemy ships are within Range 1–3, place 3 Time tokens here and perform an additional maneuver.

upgrades.name: Attack · Twin Strike
upgrades.text: When attacking at Range 1–2, place 3 Time tokens here. Make two 3-die attacks against the target; this ship may reroll its Critical results.

upgrades.name: Activation Phase · Disable Shields
upgrades.text: At the end of Activation, target an enemy at Range 1–2 and roll an attack die. On a Critical result, disable and discard its remaining shields; the target skips its Perform Attack Dice step.

upgrades.name: Defense · Range One Penalty
upgrades.text: When defending during Roll Attack Dice, attacking ships roll -1 attack die against this ship, or -3 attack dice at Range 1.

upgrades.name: Defense · Sacrifice Shield
upgrades.text: When defending while this ship is not cloaked, destroy 1 active shield and add 3 Evade results.
